name: ddd

pattern.for: a part of a product designed with domain-driven design: its subdomains, bounded contexts, events and aggregates

summary: Domain-driven design for the parts of a product that follow it: subdomains, bounded contexts and their map, event storming (events, commands, reactions, read models, external systems) and the tactical model (aggregates, entities, value objects, business rules, domain services), traced to the requirements and components of the architecture.

changelog.note: The studio's page: The domain model.
capture-form's three choices named in words; no quoting the engine.
Every conversation in plain language: no codes, ids or engine output, technical details only when asked (engine 0.11.22).
model-domain captures through OTO's capture-form with its menu, and is handed a part by the software-architecture pack.
ddd declares itself a pattern of software-architecture (model-domain). Needs OTO 0.11.17.
The DDD pattern for a part of a product: the ddd ontology and model-domain.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
